title: Breathing Easier: PM2.5 in Kathmandu schools
short_plain_language_description: Sensors in 40 Kathmandu schools, open data and awareness sessions for students and teachers.
activities: Sensor installation; dashboard; awareness sessions; health camps; policy brief
outcomes_measured: Measurement only: no exposure, health or policy outcome reported
limitations: Outputs are self-reported; measurement in schools is not a reduction in children's exposure or illness.

title: Clean Energy Nepal low-cost monitoring network

outcomes_measured: Measurement only: no exposure, health or policy outcome reported
limitations: Programme page is undated; funder of the earlier 10-city plan not stated.

title: Indi-SET independent sensor evaluation

limitations: Tests measurement accuracy only; says nothing about emission or exposure reduction.

title: Jakarta PM2.5 and child pneumonia white paper
short_plain_language_description: Analysis linking PM2.5 to pneumonia prevalence in Jakarta's under-fives.
